title: Nested-open compatibility of the constructed comparisons
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $i:W\hookrightarrow U$ an inclusion of arbitrary opens. Suppose the derived module categories on $X,U,W$ exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a K-injective complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Supply adjunctions $a_U:D(L_U)\dashv Rj_{U*}$ and $a_W:D(L_W)\dashv Rj_{W*}$ for the functors of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] and [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For the constructed comparisons $c_U,c_W$ of [def-pc-open-image-complex-comparison-iso], the fixed underived complex restriction $\rho_{U,W}$ of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data] satisfies $c_W\circ Q(\rho_{U,W})=\rho^{D}_{U,W}(Q(I))\circ c_U$, where $\rho^D$ is schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction for $a_U,a_W$.

source.place: Tag 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), first proof paragraph and displayed restriction/direct-image sequence; Tag 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open)

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left and homEquiv_id directly to the supplied derived W-adjunction. The intervening composite is the identity by transported_left_triangle: naturality of schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso inverse moves the U-unit past the comparison, after which Functor.map_comp and the supplied U-adjunction left_triangle_components cancel the U-unit and counit. This private helper involves only one adjunction and proves the transported left triangle, not the duplicated two-adjunction unit_comp_mate theorem. Neither supplied adjunction needs to be canonical.

The underived open pushforward for U is fully faithful (Mathlib Scheme.Modules.pushforward Full and Faithful). Therefore the U-restriction of its transported unit is an isomorphism by Adjunction isIso of L.map unit. Restrict further along i and conjugate by schemeOpenRestrictionCompIso to show that W-restriction of the U-unit is an isomorphism. Degreewise this gives an isomorphism of restricted complexes via HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components. Mathlib NatIso.isIso_map_iff applied to mapDerivedCategoryFactors transports its localization to show D(L_W)(Q(eta_U)) is an isomorphism. These are the proved private isIso_smaller_restriction_unit, isIso_exact_localized_map and isIso_smaller_derived_unit helpers.

For maps into a right-adjoint object, precomposition by u is injective whenever L(u) is epi: apply the inverse adjunction homEquiv, use homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, and cancel L(u). Apply this with u=Q(eta_U) and the supplied W-adjunction, using the preceding isomorphism. It suffices to prove the comparison equation after precomposing by Q(eta_U).

The concrete termwise restriction carries eta_U to eta_W by schemeOpenModuleImage_unit_restriction in every degree. Apply Q and use schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison_unit for U and W. The left composite becomes the W derived unit, and the right composite is the U derived unit followed by the derived mate. The first step equates these, completing the cancellation argument without any new unproved statements.

proof_origin.note: Shorter unit-cancellation proof. Open restriction of the larger unit is invertible; equality of maps into the smaller right adjoint follows from the already proved unit comparison. No derived-counit localization or rightAdjointUniq normalization calculation is required here. Repair of the duplicate-theorem return: removed unit_comp_mate, using Mathlib homEquiv_naturality_left and homEquiv_id directly with a strictly smaller transported-left-triangle helper. The source module unit_comp_mate is private and cannot be imported by name; no other module or interface was changed. Second reading removes isIso_map_of_natIso in favor of Mathlib NatIso.isIso_map_iff.

theorem schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison_restriction
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {W U : X.Opens} (i : W ⟶ U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (adjU : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι)
    (adjW : (schemeOpenRestriction X W).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X i I) ≫
        (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X W I adjW).hom =
      (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X U I adjU).hom ≫
        schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X i adjU adjW (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)
